dct_creator_sm: Anglehart-Nunes, Jessy (École de technologie supérieure). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6094-0596
dct_description_sm: This dataset presents raw results related to the development of an integrated objective-subjective weighting method based on principal component analysis. This dataset documents the principal results presented in the paper and its supplementary materials. The computation method was applied to three comparative case studies from the literature.
dct_title_s: Dataset of A novel integrated objective-subjective weighting method using principal component analysis to correct correlation bias among criteria in sustainability decision making
